MailContent.SourceString:
新的一年开始了，祝你新年快乐！以及今天其实也是我的生日！
我的生日碰巧和新年是同一天，所以，我从来没有过自己的生日派对，但是能在生日吃上更丰盛的一顿新年大餐。可惜管理局没有新年聚餐的传统，这两年的生日和新年，我都是自己过。没了庆祝活动，自己一个人在街上闲逛的时候，会觉得这不过也是普通的日子。
普通的日子没什么不好，但重要的是今天休假，不找点事做太无聊了！
所以，，，你今天有空吗？要不要一起出来逛逛？一切开销我全包！
MailContent.LocalizedString:
A new year's started—happy New Year! And actually, today's my birthday too!
My birthday just happens to fall on New Year's Day, so I've never had a birthday party all to myself. Still, I get a more lavish New Year's meal. Too bad the Bureau doesn't have a tradition of dining together on New Year's, so for the past two years, I've spent both my birthday and New Year's alone. Without any celebration, wandering the streets by myself makes it feel like just another ordinary day.
There's nothing wrong with an ordinary day, but the important thing is that I'm off today, and doing nothing would be way too boring!
So… um, are you free today? Want to go wander around together? I'll cover everything!

MailContent.SourceString:
忙起来的时候就容易忘了自己的生日，还是队友们提醒我的，顺便建议我当天给自己放个假。
过生日放个假确实是人之常情，但这话从那两个人口中说出来，我不由得担心要是我一天不呆在办公室的话，可能会发生什么不妙的事情……
结果，哈……一进门就被礼花喷了一脸。
竟然连我会折返都在计划之内……这事反思起来，竟还有些趣味，就分享给你听吧。
MailContent.LocalizedString:
When work gets busy, it's easy to forget my own birthday. My teammates were the ones who reminded me, and they even suggested I take the day off.
Taking a day off for your birthday is pretty common, but hearing that from those two, I couldn't help worrying that if I stayed away from the office for a day, something bad might happen…
And sure enough, ha… the moment I walked in, I got a face full of confetti.
They'd even planned for me to turn around and leave… Looking back, it was actually rather amusing, so I thought I'd share it with you.

MailContent.SourceString: 谢谢你的生日祝福和邀约。今天还有训练计划，或许我不应该藉由「生日」给自己找怠惰一天的借口……本意如此，但浔告诉我「偶尔也该好好放松自己，特别是在值得庆贺的日子里」。或许……「生日」也算是值得庆贺的日子吧。至少，能遇见你们我很开心。对了，浔给了我几张赏花的门票，似乎是要大家一起去。这个时节，在开什么花呢……？（思索）
MailContent.LocalizedString: Thank you for your birthday wishes and the invitation. I still have training scheduled today, so perhaps I shouldn't use my "birthday" as an excuse to slack off… At least, that's what I thought, but Hotori told me, "You should relax once in a while, especially on days worth celebrating". Perhaps… a birthday does count as a day worth celebrating. At the very least, I'm very glad to have met you all. Oh, and Hotori gave me a few tickets for some flower viewing. It seems there are enough tickets for all of us? I wonder what's blooming this time of year…? (thinking)

MailContent.SourceString:
今天早上我去买饭团的时候，便利店老板说今天正好在做活动，购物积分可以抽奖。我抽到了一个饭团！这还是我第一次中奖呢，运气真好。中午的时候又收到了很多同事送的礼物，可琳还包下了一整层的Firmament餐厅说是要庆祝。在我的家乡，只有小孩子可以过生日，庆祝又成功长大了一岁。生日，真是一个好日子。
我想邀请你来我的生日，不是要求！只是希望你能来，我想把饭团送给你，这样，是不是好运气也可以分你一点呢？
MailContent.LocalizedString:
This morning, when I went to buy a rice ball at the convenience store, the owner said they were running a promotion, and I could use my store points for a lottery. I actually won a rice ball! It was my first time winning anything, so I felt really good about myself. At noon, I got a lot of gifts from my coworkers, and Kolinsna even reserved an entire floor of the Firmament to celebrate. In my hometown, only children actually celebrate birthdays, as a way of marking another year of growing up. But… Birthdays really are wonderful days.
I'd like to invite you to my birthday celebration—not that I'm demanding it! I just hope you can come. I want to give you the rice ball. That way, maybe I can share a little of my good luck with you, too?

MailTitle.LocalizedString: If I Were to Make a Wish…

MailSubTitle.LocalizedString: If I Were to Make a Wish…

MailContent.SourceString:
有很长一段时间，我都不太喜欢许愿。因为总觉得许下的愿望都会以某种扭曲的方式实现，就像一场恶劣的玩笑。
不过，后面我慢慢想通了。或许只是因为我的愿望太过庞大奢侈，才会让贪心的自己遭到反噬。如果只是许下一些小小的、可以通过努力亲手实现的愿望，命运也就没什么理由再责怪我了，对吧？
今天是我的生日，是可以名正言顺许愿的日子。我的愿望是……啊，说出来会不会不灵了？不过，如果你愿意来和我一起分享生日蛋糕，我想这个愿望的一小部分，应该就能实现了吧。
MailContent.LocalizedString:
For a long time, I didn't really like making wishes. I always felt that anything I wished for would end up coming true in some twisted way, like a bad joke.
But little by little, I started to understand. Maybe my wishes were just too big, too extravagant, and it was my own greed that came back to bite me. If I only wish for little things—the kind I can bring about myself with effort—then fate won't have a cruel joke to play on me, right?
Today is my birthday, so I finally have a perfectly good excuse to make a wish. My wish is… Ah, if I say it out loud, won't it cancel out? Still, if you'd be willing to come share birthday cake with me, then I think a small part of that wish will have already come true.

MailContent.SourceString:
00:00，祝哈尼娅生日快乐！！！
嘿嘿，我可是特地定了一个闹钟，从今天的零点开始一直到第二天的零点前，每一分钟都要好好的庆祝！这可是一年只有一次的纪念日，无论到多少岁，生日都是值得祝贺的日子，礼物蛋糕还有祝福怎么样都不会嫌多的。
按照计划，从现在开始到早餐前，时间刚好重温一遍我最喜欢的番，零点的时候已经按下播放键了，第一项计划正在完美进行。早餐后约了朋友们一起去买礼物，我还想试着亲手给自己做一个蛋糕。鉴定师要一起来吗？拜托了，一起来吧，有了鉴定师的祝福，一定会是一个最棒的生日的！
啊，差点忘记了，这个时候鉴定师可能已经休息了。那今年的生日愿望是，鉴定师醒来后看到邮件可以陪哈尼娅过生日！一定会实现的吧！
MailContent.LocalizedString:
00:00, happy birthday to Haniel!!!
Hehe, I even set an alarm just for this—I'm going to celebrate every single minute from midnight today until midnight tomorrow! A day such as this only comes once a year, after all. No matter how old you get, birthdays are always worth celebrating, and you can never have too many gifts, cakes, or birthday wishes!
According to my schedule, from now until breakfast is just enough time to re-watch all my favorite anime. I already pressed play right at midnight, so the first part of the plan is already going perfectly. After breakfast, I'm meeting up with some friends to go shopping, and I want to try baking myself a cake too. Appraiser, do you want to come with? Please, please come with! With your blessing, it's sure to be the best birthday ever!
Ah, I almost forgot—the Appraiser is probably already asleep at this hour. Then my birthday wish this year is that when the Appraiser wakes up and sees this email, you'll come celebrate Haniel's birthday with me!

MailContent.SourceString:
吼吼吼！烤箱里正在烤制一个超级大秘密——用掉一整根香草荚的戚风蛋糕！是我严格跟着呗果上的教程烤出来的！味道有保证，绝对不会失手！新鲜出炉后再点缀些薄荷叶，嘿嘿，我都等不及啦！
可可你一定会来的对吧？我已经把你的餐叉准备好了唷！
MailContent.LocalizedString:
Heh heh heh! There's a super big secret baking in the oven—a chiffon cake made with an entire vanilla bean! I followed a tutorial on Bagel to the letter! Deliciousness guaranteed—I definitely, definitely didn't mess it up! Once it's fresh out of the oven, I'll top it with some mint leaves. Hehe, I can't wait!
You'll come, right, Coco? I've already got your plate and fork on the table!

MailContent.SourceString:
生日，可以放假。安魂曲，不记得生日，但是，也想放假……然后，嗯……「生日的意义说到底也是由人赋予的，所以小弥撒你选自己喜欢的一天当生日就可以喽~」——白藏他们……这么说。
所以，安魂曲的生日，是今天。
……大家都说，好突然。但是，给安魂曲……番茄冰淇淋蛋糕。好吃。生日，很开心。鉴定师，也来一起？
MailContent.LocalizedString:
To me, birthdays mean: a day off. Lacrimosa doesn't remember her birthday, but… Lacrimosa remembers wanting a day off… And, um… "A birthday's meaning is something people give to it… So, Mosa, you can just pick any day you like as your birthday~"—that's what Baicang and the others said to me.
So Lacrimosa's birthday is today!
… Everyone said it was very sudden. But Lacrimosa got… tomato ice-cream cake. Delicious. Birthdays make Lacrimosa very happy. Appraiser, you'll come too, right?

MailContent.SourceString:
斯特利从今早起便难得热闹。
几个小家伙嘴里念着「日常布置」，可他们商量「生日惊喜」的动静倒是算不上小。我原想着把后几日的事务提前整理好，却被他们按住，说这种日子不该再埋头忙碌，更不该独自待着。
若鉴定师今日恰好有空，不妨来店里坐坐，喝杯咖啡，聊聊近况，也好让我在这群小家伙的「惊喜」里，稍微松口气。
MailContent.LocalizedString:
Sterry has been unusually lively since this morning.
The little ones keep calling it "routine decorating," but they're making far too much noise for something they're planning as a "birthday surprise". I was going to sort out the next few days' work in advance, but they stopped me, saying that on a day like this, I shouldn't be burying myself in work—much less spending it alone.
If the Appraiser has some time today, stop by the shop for a bit. Let's catch up over a cup of coffee. It'd help me catch my breath amid all this "surprise" business.

MailContent.SourceString:
刚来到海特洛的时候，我还没想到「过生日」也会变得这么让人期待，有同伴在身边的意义真的非同寻常。薄荷嚷嚷着这个季节一定要有户外烤肉派对，伊洛伊也答应会来，虽然还是老样子非得跟我互呛两句。不过总觉得还是有点不够热闹——薄荷是这么说的，毕竟这样的聚会就是人越多才越有气氛。
好像有点扯远了，谢谢你的礼物和祝福……如果你也能来就太好了。
MailContent.LocalizedString:
When I first came to Hethereau, I never imagined birthdays would become something I'd look forward to this much. Having friends by your side really does make all the difference. Mint kept saying that weather like this absolutely requires an outdoor BBQ party, and Iroi said she'd come too—even if she still had to trade a few barbs with me like usual. But it still feels like it's missing a little something, or, well, that's what Mint said. After all, gatherings like this are way better when there are more people around.
I guess I'm rambling a bit. Thanks for your gift and birthday wishes… If you could come too, that would be wonderful!

MailContent.SourceString:
今天是柯林斯家族成立的大日子，值得好好的庆祝一番！
我昨天问过大叔了，他说今天很可能是大晴天欸！好天气是不错啦，不过外面真的好热……那就去海边吧！大海，烧烤，还有沙滩排球，你是不是也觉得这是个绝妙的好主意！不愧是柯林斯一代目，又完美的解决了问题。
那就这么说定啦！作为柯林斯的荣誉成员，你一定要来哦！
MailContent.LocalizedString:
Today is the Coluccis' big founding-day bash, so we've gotta celebrate it properly!
I asked Adler yesterday, and he said today's probably gonna be nice and sunny! Good weather's great and all, but man, it's really hot out there… So we should go to the beach! The ocean, barbecue, and beach volleyball—don't you think that's the recipe for a fun day?! As expected of the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis—another perfect solution!
It's settled! As an honorary member of the Coluccis, you absolutely have to come!

MailContent.SourceString:
从在斯特利工作后，我也会在节假日收到寄给自己的快递。不过，即便是有生日假期，早起处理大家的诸多礼物也还是会让人有些手足无措。
回信处理完后，我照例进行了机车保养。今天倒也没有什么特别的任务，只是在山野间随意骑行。比起一贯追求效率的工作状态，这样无目地的兜风，反而能注意到那些平时不会留意的景色。只是周围没什么人驻留欣赏，多少有些可惜。我把位置记录了下来，不过山路曲折，不算好找，如果你有兴趣，我可以带你去看看。
MailContent.LocalizedString:
Ever since I started working at Sterry, I've been getting packages sent to me, even on holidays. Since I took the day off for my birthday, getting up early to sort through everyone's gifts leaves me a little overwhelmed.
After I finished replying to all the messages, I did my usual maintenance on my motorcycle. I didn't have any special assignments today, so I just took a leisurely ride through the countryside. Compared to the efficiency I usually have at work, a joyride with no destination lets me notice things I normally never would. It's a pity there wasn't anyone around to enjoy the scenery with. I saved the coordinates, though the mountain roads are winding and the place isn't easy to find. If you're interested, I can take you there.

MailContent.SourceString:
今天早上收到了小布妮送来的花束，才记起来是什么日子。来伊波恩之前，鄙人鲜少在意这样的日子，而现在，按照娜娜莉的说法，生日这样的日子还是该庆祝一番的吧。
话说回来，上月做的鲜花酱正好到了开封的日子，拿来做些点心花茶，鉴定师若是有空便来尝尝吧。
MailContent.LocalizedString:
It wasn't until Little Buni brought me a bouquet this morning that I was reminded what day it was. Before coming to Eibon, I rarely paid attention to occasions such as these—but as Nanally says, birthdays are important to celebrate!
As it just so happens, the flower jam I made last night is ready to open. I'll use it to make some pastries and tea. If you have the time, Appraiser, do stop by for a taste!

MailContent.SourceString: 和大家一起度过的又一个生日……很开心，很温暖，就像妈妈织的这条围巾一样……谢谢大家……
MailContent.LocalizedString: Another birthday with everyone… I'm so excited! I feel all warm and cuddly, just like the scarf my mother once knitted… Thank you, everyone…

MailContent.SourceString: 我的生日？再让我想到那些做作的裙子和晚宴上唾液纷飞的老头老太——我真的会呕出来。明明有更有趣的事啊~不如来和我一起过节？满街都是张牙舞爪的怪物，有多少人打着“装扮”的幌子，把平日难以窥见的黑暗面掏出来了呢？时不时地还能抓到些新鲜、有力的肉体，散发出诱人的气息，让人忍不住想舔舐品尝……嗯？我说的是孩子们手里捧着的糖果和杯子蛋糕。你在想什么？
MailContent.LocalizedString: My birthday? If you make me think about those pretentious dresses and all those spit-flinging old fossils at formal dinners again, I'll throw up everywhere. There are way more fun things to do~ Why not come celebrate with me instead? The streets are packed with fang-baring monsters—how many people do you think are using "costumes" as an excuse to drag out the darkness they normally keep hidden, deep down? Now and then, you can even get your hands on some fresh, tender flesh, with such an alluring scent that you can't help wanting to lick and taste… Huh? I'm talking about the candy and cupcakes everyone buys. What were you thinking?

MailContent.SourceString:
真想知道，你们怎么一个个都能把生日记得这么清楚？之前娜娜莉还追着我问，我哪有这种……哪记得这种小孩才盼着过的日子，谁知道她又找阿德勒问，还真给她问出了个日子……肯定是阿德勒随口说来糊弄娜娜莉的，给她记住真的当我的生日了，结果每年这时候她都要折腾个好久，也不知道今年会准备些什么……
我可没在期待，只是不想扫她们的兴罢了！反正不管怎么样都是老一套吧，一个好大好大的蛋糕还有一堆不知道从哪翻出的小东西……总之，你今晚可不准迟到，迟到的话，就等着吃鬼郎丸啃剩的蛋糕吧！
MailContent.LocalizedString:
Seriously, how do you all manage to remember birthdays so clearly? Nanally was badgering me about it before, and I was like, who even remembers that kind of thing… a day only little kids get hyped for? Then she went and asked Adler, and he actually gave her a date… He must've just tossed out some random number to get Nanally off his back, but she actually took it seriously and started treating it like my real birthday. So every year around this time she ends up making a huge thing out of it, and I really have no idea what she's planning this year…
It's not like I'm looking forward to it. I just don't want to kill the mood. Anyway, it's probably the same old routine no matter what—one giant cake and a bunch of little odds and ends she dug up from who knows where… Anyway, you'd better not be late tonight. If you are, then you can eat whatever Kiroumaru leaves behind!

MailContent.SourceString: 嗯？今天不是我的生日啊，你是不是记错了？不会是把我跟别人搞混了吧……（捂住胸口）这样真的很让我伤心！作为补偿，再送我一份生日礼物如何——开玩笑的。谢谢你的祝福和礼物，我很喜欢。相信我，我会把今天列为人生中必须纪念的一百件美事之一！其他的九十九件……嗯，就从现在开始想~
MailContent.LocalizedString: Hm? But today isn't my birthday. Did you get the date wrong? Or did you mix me up with someone else…? (clutches chest) That's really hurtful! To make it up to me, how about giving me another birthday gift? Just kidding. Thank you for the birthday wishes and the gift. I really like it. Believe me, I'm putting today down as one of the one hundred beautiful things in life worth living for! The other ninety-nine… hmm, I'll need to start a list~

MailContent.SourceString: 喔，招财宝送来的生日祝福和礼物……一定很具备招财属性吧！这个看起来平平无奇的东西有什么说法？据我鉴定恐怕来头不小，很有眼光嘛。嗯~我会考虑摆进店里风水最好的地方。至于「祝店长财源广进」的祝福我就先收下了，但如果没有实现的话……呵呵~就请我的招财宝加油工作来让它早日实现吧？
MailContent.LocalizedString: Oh, birthday wishes and a gift from my Precious… it must be brimming with good-fortune energy! What's the story behind this ordinary-looking little thing? By my standards, it must be something special. You've got a good eye. Hmm~ I'll think about putting it in the spot with the best feng shui in the shop. As for your wish, well… I'll accept it for now—but if it doesn't come true… hehe~ then my Precious will have to work a bit harder to make it happen, right?!

MailContent.SourceString:
鉴定师，今天是我的生日哦OwO原本打算开个生日派对然后邀请你的，但恰巧碰上去医院定期检查的日子，好遗憾。
仔细想想好像去年也是这样。前年也是这样。大前年……好像一直都是这样。想起来了，上一次生日派对是九年前，也是在医院过的。
噢……因为检查是每年定期的，所以每年都是和生日同一天。
恍然大悟><！明明我每年都在期待生日派对><！！
那么总之！如果检查结束了还有时间的话，我就来找你玩OwO我们一起聚餐，我请客，就当是个小小的派对好啦~
哎呀，时间到了，要进诊室了。回见~
MailContent.LocalizedString:
Appraiser, it's my birthday today, OwO. I was going to throw a birthday party and invite you, but it just so happens to be my regular checkup day at the hospital, UwU.
Now that I think about it, it was like this last year too. And the year before that. And the year before that… I… I think it's always been like this. Oh, right—the last birthday party I had was nine years ago, and it was at the hospital too!
Because the checkup happens every year, it always falls on the same day as my birthday.
Aha, I understand now… ><!!
Anyway! If there's still time after the checkup, I'll come find you and hang out, OwO. We can grab a meal together—my treat! It'll be our little celebration~
Oops, time's up! I have to go into the exam room now. See you~~~~

MailContent.SourceString:
其实，我并不清楚自己的生日，也不知道自己的具体岁数。这个日子，是伊南娜捡到我之后赐予我名姓的日子。往年，除了「红字」的几位，也不会有人知道这个日子，也不会关心。
不过想来，在这余下的漫长时光里，毫无标的地活着，总让人觉得缺了些什么。为了防止我也把它忘记，我决定告诉你，要是明年没忘，我明年也会来说一次。你就把今天当个坏日子吧，或者如果做得到的话，把它忘掉也罢，毕竟你要记的其它日子多着呢。
不过，如果你真的愿意祝福我的话，多谢了，鉴定师。
MailContent.LocalizedString:
To be honest, I don't really know when my birthday is, or even how old I am. Instead, this is the day Inanna found me and gave me my name. In past years, aside from a few people from "The Scarlet Letter," no one knew about this day, nor did anyone care.
But when I think about the amount of living I still have to do, spending so much time without anything to mark it by always feels… wrong. So, I decided to tell you—if only to keep myself from forgetting this date, too. If I remember by this time next year, I'll come remind you. Just think of today as an unfortunate day, or forget about it entirely. After all, you have plenty of other days to remember.
Still, if you really are willing to wish me well, then thank you, Appraiser.

MailContent.SourceString:
鉴定师鉴定师，可能会有点突然，但今天是我生日!
过去每年的这个日子，我都会带着生日蛋糕带到上晴塔顶，天上有几颗一等星，我就点几根蜡烛，然后等呀等，如果有彗星经过的话，就赶紧深呼吸许一个愿望——然后，它就会带着我的电波，去银河里转一圈！这样，全宇宙的星星就都收到我的邀请了!
加入六队之后，我也邀请过大家和小贞一起去开宇宙生日派对，但他们好像更喜欢在办公室里开，不过无论是在哪里，我都很开心，因为生日就是要开心地过~
鉴定师今天有空的话，可以和我一起玩吗？一起去沙滩？或者去港区转转……噢！我们去噗卡乐园吧！我一直想和鉴定师一起、噗卡乐园把所有地方都玩一遍！可以吗？
MailContent.LocalizedString:
Appraiser, Appraiser, this might be sudden, but today's my birthday!
Every year on this day, I bring a birthday cake to the top of Hethereau Skytower. I light one candle for every star in the sky, then wait, and wait, and wait. If a comet passes by, I take a deep breath and make a wish! By doing so, the comet will carry my wish all around the galaxy! That way, every star in the universe gets my invitation!
After joining ETD-6, I invited everyone, and even Xiaozhen, to a cosmic-themed birthday party, but they seem to prefer celebrating in the office. Still, I'm happy regardless of where we celebrate, because birthdays are supposed to be fun~
If you're free today, Appraiser, will you come hang out with me? We could go to the beach, or walk around the Harbor District… Oh! Let's go to Pukaland! I've always wanted to explore Pukaland with you! Can we? Can we?!

MailContent.SourceString:
生日……吗？呵呵，对我来说可是一个相当陌生的词汇呢。
其实我并不知道今天是不是我的真正的生日，在四处漫游的岁月里，为了不让自己对流逝的时间失去感知，我便选择了今天作为人类历法中一年的开始与结束。在这样平淡的一日，我会给自己编织一个花环，命名一颗星星，或是与鸟群一起开启一场小小的旅程……啊，这些都是很久以前的事了。
既然我赋予了这天特殊的意义，那想来还是做一些特殊的事才算合适。我想想，要不就在房间里看一整天的电影？还是久违地出门走走，在城市里探险呢？
如果你能陪我一起，那就更好啦。
不许拒绝哦，今天我才是主角，主角的愿望肯定会得到百分百的满足吧！
MailContent.LocalizedString:
Birthday…? Hehe, that's a pretty unfamiliar word to me.
To tell you the truth, I don't know whether today is my actual birthday or not. During my years of wandering, I chose this day to mark the passing of each year on the human calendar, just so I wouldn't lose track of time. On that otherwise ordinary day, I'd weave myself a flower crown, name a star, or set off on a little journey with a flock of birds… Ah, but that was a long time ago.
Since I've made this day special, I suppose I should do something special as well. Let's see… Should I stay in and watch movies all day? Or finally get out and explore the city?
It'd be even better if you joined me.
And no saying no! Today's my day, so every wish I have today must come true, right?

MailContent.SourceString:
谈起生日，总觉得熟悉又陌生。在我印象中，生日应该是一个充满仪式感的日子。而随着年龄的增长，渐渐地就把这一天当作了一年中普通的一天度过了。所以今天哈尼娅和娜娜莉抱着生日蛋糕冲进livehouse里的时候，我着实是吓了一跳。后来才得知这是她们与店长串通好的，要在这一天给我一个惊喜。看到这一幕说完全没有被感动肯定是骗人的。也是这个时候，我突然很庆幸没有选择放弃音乐，没有选择放弃乐队，而是选择加入了「猫头音！！！！」。听说她们还联系了海月和铃羽……真是喜欢麻烦别人的小鸟和小猫。
所以……那你会来吗？许久不过生日了，偶尔来一次充满仪式感的生日派对倒也不错？
期待着与你相见。
MailContent.LocalizedString:
Birthdays feel both familiar and unfamiliar to me. I used to think birthdays deserved a proper celebration. But as I got older, I gradually started treating mine like any other day. So when Haniel and Nanally burst into the live music venue today carrying a birthday cake, they really caught me off guard. I only found out later that they'd planned the surprise with the manager. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't touched. Right then, I was so glad I hadn't given up on music or playing in a band, and that I'd joined "THE WHOOTS!!!!" I heard they even contacted Aurelia and Suzuha… That little bird and cat just love getting everyone involved, don't they?
So… you're coming, right? I haven't celebrated my birthday in ages. Maybe making a bit of an occasion of it wouldn't be so bad?
I'm looking forward to seeing you.

MailTitle.SourceString: 无数生日设定的其中之一

MailSubTitle.SourceString: 无数生日设定的其中之一

MailContent.SourceString:
其实在大家眼里，我的生日也都是不一样的设定呢，所以一年里可能会去和不同的朋友聚在一起过很多很多次的生日哦！虽然听上去是有点累人，但反正是开心的事情所以多做几次倒也没问题！
不过，如果只能用一个唯一的日期来算的话，就算作是这个日期好了——我作为一个「人」，到管理局就职的纪念日！
啊，感觉是不是也有点接近，差不多在新学年交到了第一个朋友的、那种感觉的日期？~*
那么，今天也就小小地、偷偷地为自己庆生一下好了！嘿嘿，要保守秘密哦！
MailContent.LocalizedString:
You know, everyone seems to have their own idea of when my birthday is, so I could end up celebrating it with different friends again and again throughout the year! It sounds a little exhausting, sure, but if it's fun, why not do it more than once?
But if I had to choose just one date, I'd pick this one: the anniversary of the day I joined the Bureau as a "person"!
Huh... I guess that's a little like the day you make your first friend at the start of a new school year, isn't it?~*
So I think I'll have a tiny, secret birthday celebration today! Hehe, don't tell anyone!
